in_english.long_meaning: The Christian name Krescencja is derived from Crescenzio, a saint martyr, who firmly held his faith in martyrdom and donated his life for Christ. Crescenzio, the martyr, was born in Northern Africa and obtained martyrdom during the persecution of Diocletian. The name Krescencja spread in Eastern Europe in the Middle Ages to signify Christians. It is a name that symbolizes growth and increase of faith in the Christian tradition
